name: breadcrumbs
summary: Renders a labelled breadcrumb trail of safe linked ancestors and one current page.

agent.useWhen: A page has a navigable hierarchy with one or more ancestor destinations and a current location.
agent.avoidWhen: The trail is not hierarchical, the current item must be a link, or destinations are not safe internal/HTTP(S) hrefs.

invariants: At least one linked ancestor is followed by exactly one nonlinked current page.
Ancestor hrefs use the closed safe destination policy; labels and href attributes are escaped.
All labels are nonblank plain text; no arbitrary URLs, HTML, routes, or scripts are admitted.
The fragment contains exactly one [[attributes]], [[label]], and [[items]] slot; expansion is exact and single-pass.
